description.text: Class : 1. Rudimentary Chinese Class I (for beginners) 2.Chinese class II for Higher Level(The students will be streamed based on their Chinese levels.) Main courses:Intensive Chinese Reading, Chinese Reading, Chinese Listening and Speaking Aim of Training:The course are designed to show students to gain a basic understanding of China as well as Chinese language and culture. Click to here:Details of course structure Chinese Class of WFU (click the pic to enlarge)

duration.text: The Summer Vacation Chinese Course at Weifang University is a 6 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 41 USD/per week ￥ 300 CNY/per week

materials.text: 1.Copy of passport or other valid IDs With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.Resume Written in Chinese or in English

requirements.text: 1.The acceptable applicants include students sent by the foreign educational institutions and legal non-governmental organizations and self-paid individuals from foreign countries. 2.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport 3.Applicants must be in good health
